description: Orders a load balancer in a private network, billed by the hour from now (the account needs 24 hours of credit), or by the month (7.30 CAD) or the year (73 CAD) with billing. A monthly or yearly period comes out of credit if it covers it; otherwise billing.pending_invoice holds the invoice to pay and it stays hourly until then. Ready within minutes (status pending → active); pools and listeners can be added meanwhile. Retrying the same call is safe. Scope: vms.create.

billing.description: hourly (default), monthly (the price of 730 hours, paid in advance) or yearly (ten months). Ask the user; monthly or yearly needs credit or an invoice paid by the user.

idempotency_key.description: Your own unique value per order. By default one is derived from the call.

vpc.description: Private network whose machines will be the targets (list_vpcs).

name: create_load_balancer
title: Create a load balancer
